jobs.occupation: Senior Logistics Coordinator & Import/Export Analyst (m/f/d) (Fachkraft - Logistik/Materialwirtschaft)
jobs.description: At Azenta Life Sciences, we support some of the world's leading pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and research organizations by managing the samples and materials that underpin scientific discovery.Join our Griesheim Biobank team as EU Sample Management Coordinator (Logistics Coordinator & Import/Export Analyst).How You´ll Add ValueAs EU Sample Management Coordinator (m/w/d), you will coordinate the shipment of biological samples, laboratory materials, and related goods throughout Europe and internationally. In this role, you will also help ensure compliance with applicable customs, import/export, and trade regulations by supporting the accurate preparation, review, and coordination of shipment documentation and related processes.The role offers a combination of hands-on logistics coordination, customs administration, customer communication, and process improvement. Success in this position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while ensuring shipments meet internal standards and external regulatory requirements.This is an opportunity to join an established international organization and play a key role in supporting scientific and clinical research projects across Europe.What You´ll Do- You are part of a four-person logistics team that serves as the central point of contact for logistics matters across our operations, as well as for customers and service providers.- You coordinate and manage shipping orders in day-to-day operations, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant execution.- Your routine tasks include packaging and labeling goods ready for shipment, as well as preparing cover letters, freight documents, and customs documentation.- You support import and export compliance activities, including reviewing shipment data for customs relevance, helping ensure correct classification, documentation completeness, and adherence to internal procedures and applicable regulations.- You are responsible for coordinating with customs authorities, brokers, and other relevant parties to ensure smooth border crossings, including in time-critical cases.- You help monitor and maintain records related to import/export activities and support internal compliance checks, audits, and process documentation updates where required.- You support the continuous development of our logistics processes and service offerings, including with a focus on compliance, efficiency, and sustainability.- You also support incoming goods processing when needed, checking for completeness and informing the relevant departments, for example in the case of deliveries of chemicals and reagents.- Additionally, you are responsible for inventory, as well as managing and ordering logistics-related materials.- You understand and strictly adhere to standard operating procedures (SOPs) in English and contribute to maintaining high ethical and quality standards in all shipment-related activities.What You´ll Bring- Successfully completed vocational training or a degree in business administration, logistics, customs, or a similar qualification.- Practical work experience in logistics, customs, import/export, or within a freight forwarding company.- Sound understanding of customs clearance processes, shipping documentation, and import/export compliance requirements; experience with dangerous goods is a plus.- Familiarity with trade compliance topics such as tariff classification, country of origin, customs value, restricted party screening, or license-related checks is an advantage.- Very good communication skills, both written and verbal.- Reliability clearance in accordance with Section 7 of the German Aviation Security Act (LuftSiG).- Team player with enthusiasm for working in an international team.- Proficient in standard MS Office software; advanced Excel skills and familiarity with ERP systems are an advantage.- Forward-thinking and solution-oriented approach to work, with a strong awareness of compliance and best practices.- Strong hands-on mentality.- Attention to detail and excellent prioritization skills.- Fluent in German and English (B2 level or higher).What We Offer- Become part of a company that contributes to groundbreaking scientific developments and therapies.- Positive company culture and strong teamwork across all locations.- Individual development opportunities to strengthen your international competencies and language skills.- Attractive workplace in Griesheim with excellent transport connections.- 30 days of annual leave to support a healthy work-life balance.- Partnership with pme Familienservice to support employees in all life situations.- Additional benefits include a stock purchase program, life insurance, company pension scheme, profit sharing, five additional childcare sick days, and a corporate benefits online shopping platform.ContactAzenta Germany GmbHIm Leuschnerpark 1b64347 Griesheim

jobs.description: Job descriptionIn order to support our team within the A320 Family Quality Customer Line, Airbus Operations is looking for aWorking Student (d/f/m) Data Engineering, AI & Digital DashboardsAre you passionate about data analytics, interactive dashboards, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and modern digital tools? Do you want to apply your analytical mindset and technical curiosity directly within the dynamic environment of an international aerospace group? Then come on board to help us build innovative digital solutions, explore AI-driven capabilities, and streamline work processes across our global sites! We are looking for a motivated Master's student (d/f/m) to join our team for 15–18 hours per week.- Location: Hamburg-Finkenwerder- Start Date: 15/January/2027- Duration: 12 monthsYou will receive a collectively agreed salary of at least €18.53 per hour, depending on the job. There are also special payments such as vacation pay.Definition working studentWorking students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.Your location: Hamburg FinkenwerderYou will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.Are you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.Your Role in the Team: Step right into the heartbeat of commercial aviation! As part of the transnational A320 Family Quality Customer Line, you operate directly where our end product meets the global customer interface across Hamburg, Toulouse, Mobile, and Tianjin. In this high-stakes environment, your work directly impacts the final delivery of world-class aircraft to international customers.You will be the catalyst driving our digital transformation roadmap—engineering robust data pipelines, building interactive quality dashboards, and leveraging AI and modern digital tools to support and automate workflows. If you want to see your digital solutions and automation tools directly shape operational routines and real aircraft delivery, this is your runway. We give you full ownership and autonomy to turn your ideas into live, high-visibility deliverables.Your Benefits:- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.- Work with modern/diversified technologies.- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.Your Tasks and Responsibilities:- Build Dashboards & Data Guardianship: Build interactive Skywise applications (Workshop, Slate, Contour) and backend data models. Serve as a data guardian for the team by creating and maintaining clear documentation for the data architecture and analytics landscape.- Streamline & Automate Workflows: Identify process optimization opportunities and transform them into modern, automated reporting and tools using Skywise, Google Workspace, and smart AI-assisted capabilities.- Evaluate Digital Feasibility: Assess new feature requests for data availability and technical feasibility in Skywise to help prioritize the team’s development roadmap.- Present Prototypes & Demo Solutions: Run live demonstrations of working Skywise tools in management reviews and capture user feedback to continuously improve usability.- Drive Site Adoption: Coordinate pre-release trial runs and deliver hands-on user training to onboard teams across our global sites.Desired skills and qualifications:- Education: Currently enrolled fulltime as Master's student (d/f/m) in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Data Science, Data Engineering, or a comparable technical field.- Language Skills: Fluent English skills (C1) are mandatory; German and/or French language skills are a plus.- Core Technical Foundations: Practical experience in programming with SQL, Python, and Apps Script, combined with an interest in data modeling concepts and AI-assisted tools (e.g. Prompt Engineering).- Google Workspace: Familiarity with Google Workspace tools for reporting and digital workflow integration.- Familiarity with Skywise / Palantir Foundry—or experience in relevant data & UI modules (e.g. Contour, Workshop, Slate or SQL data modeling)—is a strong plus**.**- Soft Skills: A proactive and structured self-starter with a helping-oriented mindset, dedicated to supporting end-users and solving real stakeholder needs. Excellent communication skills, critical thinking, and a sharp eye for high data quality.Are you interested and ready to take off with us? Please upload the following documents in English**: cover letter, CV, relevant certificates, and current certificate of enrollmen**t.This role requires an awareness of potential compliance risks and integrity in conduct. Both are essential prerequisites for the success, good reputation, and sustainable growth of our company.This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growthBy submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. jobs.description: About usAirbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.Job descriptionIn order to support the Component Loads Team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for aHigh-Lift Component Loads Engineer (d/f/m)We are calculating and analysing the relevant external high-lift static, fatigue and dynamic loads for all major Airbus aircraft programmes, from preliminary design through to certification. You will be working at the interface between the engineering domains of Flight Physics and Airframe, which is an excellent opportunity to discover and contribute to the integrated wing aero/loads/stress/design process.In addition, we are working on many Research and Technology projects for future aircraft programmes and are engaged in creating and defining the tools and processes of tomorrow. A key focus of our team is the parallel development of our analysis capabilities and the bespoke engineering tools required to perform these calculations efficiently.We value our trustful and transparent working environment based on mutual respect and inclusivity. We value autonomy but recognise that success is never achieved in isolation. We take wellbeing seriously, safety first starts with us. We want you to grow and develop, in this role and for the future; you can expect our support in making this happen.Your locationBremen is a charming city full of history in the northwest of Germany. In addition to being one of the country’s greenest cities, it offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights. It’s also a great place for seaside lovers, being located just an hour’s drive from the North Sea coast.Our Benefits for You- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.Your tasks and responsibilities- To provide support on all commercial programmes.- Calculate, interpret and deliver external static and fatigue loads acting on the high-lift devices in adherence with the relevant airworthiness regulations, quality processes and programme assumptions.- Support the airframe design (wing & high-lift) and high-lift systems teams in their use of this data.- Support flight test campaigns to validate load calculations.- Contribute to continuously improving our analysis capabilities.- Managing & interacting with local and trans-national project stakeholders: project managers, specialists, airframe customers, suppliers, etc.- Support airlines through Airbus Customer Services by carrying out Loads & Aeroelastics (L&A) analyses of in-service events. - jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher positions - Statistical Physics and Active Matter - (Physiker/in)
jobs.description: In the Department of Living Matter Physics (LMP) we seek to fill a number ofPostdoctoral Researcher positions.- Statistical Physics and Active Matter -The Max Planck Institute for Dynamics and Self-Organization (MPI-DS) at Göttingen, Germany, is an international, interdisciplinary and collaborative environment offering an exceptional research setting. It hosts a range of theoretical and experimental fundamental scientific research and a diverse group of researchers. Altogether, it employs about 300 people. The LMP department engages in a wide range of theoretical research aimed at understanding the dynamics of living systems from a physical perspective. The department currently hosts Ramin Golestanian (director), Philip Bittihn (group leader), Suropriya Saha (group leader), and a number of postdoctoral researchers, students, and visitors.The researchThe postdoctoral researchers will engage in theoretical and computational research in Nonequilibrium Statistical Physics and Active Matter. For more information, visit our website (http://www.ds.mpg.de/lmp (http://www.ds.mpg.de/lmp) ).Your profileWe are looking for excellent, enthusiastic and self-motivated researchers with relevant background and good communication skills to join our research team. The ideal candidate should have:- A PhD/DPhil degree (or comparable) with a background in theoretical physics, applied mathematics or related disciplines from a recognized university;- Prior experience with nonequilibrium statistical physics and a strong interest in active matter physics;- Ability and desire to work in an international team on inter-disciplinary research topics;- Good command of English, which is the working language of the department. German is an asset but not required.Our offerWe are offering excellent working conditions in a highly interdisciplinary and stimulating research environment. Salary is in accordance with the German state public service salary scale (E13 TVöD-Bund) and the corresponding social benefits. Working hours are full time. We offer opportunities regarding work life balance as well as health promotion services. The postdoctoral appointment is for two years. The starting date is flexible.The Max-Planck Society is committed to achieving the highest level of excellence and diversity. We encourage applications from women, especially in areas where they are underrepresented, which includes theoretical physics. Moreover, we are committed to providing suitable working environment for everyone including individuals with disabilities.Your applicationTo apply, please follow this link (https://s.b-ite.com/vd1cg)  and submit your CV, publication list, a statement of research interest, and contacts of two referees. In addition to the description of your proposed research, it should also briefly describe your past and current research interests and why you are interested in joining our department. Processing of applications will start after the deadline of 10th January 2027, and will stop when the positions are filled.  For questions, please contact:Prof. Dr. Ramin Golestanian Tel. +49 551 5176-100Email: golestanian-office@ds.mpg.de (https://mailto:golestanian-office@ds.mpg.de)  Max Planck Institute forDynamics and Self-OrganizationProf. Dr. Ramin GolestanianAm Faßberg 1737077 GöttingenGermany
